build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with temperature and damping parameters for NVT molecular dynamics simulations
build_bussi_thermostat: build a BussiThermostat with temperature and coupling time for stochastic velocity rescaling in MD
build_langevin_thermostat: build a LangevinThermostat with temperature and friction parameters for stochastic dynamics simulations
build_berendsen_npt_thermostat: build a BerendsenNPT thermostat with temperature and pressure for constant pressure molecular dynamics
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state for checkpointing molecular dynamics simulations using save_state and restore_state
